title: Weekly English Review
summary: This week's articles highlight significant developments across various sectors, including retail, aerospace, technology, and entertainment. Retailers are increasingly investing in entertainment to enhance customer engagement, while SpaceX achieved a milestone by successfully catching the upper stage of its Starship rocket. Nvidia has raised concerns about legal risks related to AI technology access in China, and the interim CEO of Nvidia emphasized the importance of moving forward after a leadership change. Additionally, rising mortgage rates have led to a decline in demand, and A24's box office success may provide HBO Max with a competitive advantage in streaming.
shadowing: Retailers are increasingly investing in entertainment.
Nvidia has issued a warning to its chip buyers.
Kress emphasized the importance of moving forward.
Mortgage rates moved sharply higher last week.
